declaration.preface:
Background: This policy supersedes all the policies issued previously and all the subsequent amendments stand cancelled & substituted by this policy.

Introduction: At Jay Finechem Private Limited, we are committed to implementing sustainable procurement practices that support our long-term vision of achieving environmental responsibility, ethical labour practices, and community well-being. This policy aligns with our commitment to sustainability and responsible business operations by ensuring that our procurement decisions foster positive environmental impacts uphold labour and human rights, and contribute to the well-being of the communities where we operate.
declaration.declaration:
Prioritize eco-friendly sourcing practices that reduce environmental impact, focusing on materials with low carbon footprints, renewable energy, and recyclable content.

Ensure that all suppliers adhere to fair labor practices, including equal opportunity hiring, fair wages, and providing a safe, healthy workplace for all employees.

Foster strong relationships with suppliers who respect and promote human rights, ensuring all workers within the supply chain are treated with dignity and respect.

Establish clear criteria for supplier selection, ensuring that all partners comply with our sustainability, environmental, and ethical standards.

Promote supplier diversity by actively sourcing from minority-owned, women-owned, and local businesses encourage inclusive economic growth.

Set measurable sustainability targets and collaborate with suppliers to achieve continuous improvements in their environmental, social, and governance practices.

Ensure transparent and open communication within the organization for reporting sustainability issues or policy violations.

Effective Date: 1st January 2024
declaration.scope: This Sustainable Procurement Policy applies to all employees, contractors, workers, departments, and functions within Jay Finechem Private Limited involved in procurement activities. This includes the sourcing of raw materials, goods, and services from suppliers and partners. The policy is applicable to all stages of the procurement process, including supplier selection, contract negotiation, and performance management. This policy applies to applies to all of our locations.

focusAreas: Labour Practices and Human Rights Compliance

General Sustainability Principles: We will engage in continuous dialogue with suppliers to deepen our collaborative efforts, fostering mutual understanding and improvement on sustainability practices.
Develop joint sustainability programs with key suppliers to ensure a consistent, company-wide adoption of ethical sourcing and sustainability practices.
Implement a comprehensive supplier sustainability assessment framework, which includes environmental, social, and governance (ESG) metrics, to evaluate and improve supplier performance regularly.
Increase efforts to integrate sustainability into all procurement categories by establishing specific sustainability criteria for each product group.
We prioritize sourcing from suppliers who demonstrate measurable improvements in environmental and social performance.
Environmental Responsibility and Steward: Introduce a supplier carbon footprint reduction program, setting clear targets and milestones for decreasing emissions across all suppliers.
Implement a circular economy strategy by encouraging suppliers to adopt recycling, upcycling, and sustainable waste management practices.
Work with suppliers to co-develop innovative solutions, such as eco-friendly packaging and more efficient production techniques, that reduce environmental impact.
Encourage the use of renewable energy by helping suppliers transition to clean energy sources for their operations and logistics.
Aim to provide training of Environmental issues associated with procurement activities to our procurement staff.
Labour Practices and Human Rights Compli: Strengthen supplier audits and monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with fair labor practices, including regular on-site inspections and third-party audits.
Develop a supplier training program focused on human rights and labor standards to empower suppliers with the knowledge and tools to improve their operations.
Establish a clear, accessible grievance mechanism for workers across the supply chain to ensure they have the opportunity to report concerns and violations without fear of retaliation.
Set up a supplier diversity program to increase engagement with minority-owned businesses, women owned businesses, and other underrepresented groups.
Partner with NGOs and labor rights organizations to enhance our supply chain's commitment to human rights and labor standards.
Aim to provide training of social issues associated with procurement activities to our procurement staff.

targets.target: Conduct 70% of supplier sustainability assessments annually
Achieve 50% supplier engagement on sustainability initiatives, ensuring all suppliers are fully aligned with our sustainability and ethical sourcing practices.
Incorporate sustainability criteria in 100% of procurement decisions to drive responsible purchasing across all categories.
Report supplier sustainability performance quarterly, with 100% of key suppliers achieving sustainability goals.
Aim to train 80% procurement staff on environmental related issues associated with procurement
Achieve a 10% reduction in carbon emissions across the supply chain, with suppliers setting clear reduction targets
Ensure 100% of key suppliers implement resource efficiency measures (energy, water, and materials)
Aim to ensure that 100% of high-impact suppliers monitor and report their environmental performance annually
Aim to increase partnerships by 15% with suppliers holding ISO 14001 or other environmentally friendly certifications

quantitative.area: Labour Practices and Human Rights Compliance

targets.target: Conduct 100% supplier audits to ensure compliance with international labor standards, focusing on fair treatment and safe working conditions
Aim to train 80% procurement staff on social related issues associated with procurement
Achieve zero non-compliance incidents related to labor rights violations, including child labor, forced labor, or unsafe working conditions.
Aim to increase partnerships by 15% with suppliers holding ISO 45001 or other socially responsible certifications

responsibilities.duty: Define strategic procurement goals that align with the company's sustainability objectives and values.

Oversee the implementation of the Sustainable Procurement Policy, ensuring that all procurement practices comply with environmental, ethical, and social standards. Report directly to the Managing Director on procurement performance, supplier sustainability, and the progress of ongoing sustainability initiatives.
Ensure the integration of sustainable sourcing practices in day-to-day procurement activities.
Collaborate with suppliers to ensure they meet sustainability standards, providing guidance and support to improve their practices.
Regularly monitor supplier performance, addressing non-compliance issues and recommending corrective actions as needed.

Develop and implement sustainability strategies to drive improvements in procurement practices, focusing on reducing environmental impact, promoting ethical labor practices, and fostering social responsibility.
Track and report on key sustainability metrics, ensuring that goals are met and areas for improvement are identified.
Monitor procurement activities to ensure compliance with internal sustainability policies and external regulations.
Conduct audits and assessments to evaluate the adherence of suppliers to sustainability and ethical standards.
Leads the implementation of our Sustainable Procurement Policy, ensuring adherence to sustainability goals and ethical standards across all operations.
Provides updates on policy implementation and supplier performance.
Oversees the policy's effectiveness, monitors progress, and addresses any gaps or challenges.

policy.monitoring:
Regular Reporting: Quarterly reports will outline progress on labor, human rights, and environmental sustainability in procurement practices, ensuring transparency for employees and stakeholders.

Annual Assessment: A yearly evaluation will assess the effectiveness of procurement strategies in promoting ethical labor practices and environmental responsibility, guiding future improvements.

Key Performance Indicators: Essential metrics on fair labor conditions, supplier diversity, ethical sources, carbon footprint, resource efficiency, and waste reduction will be monitored and disclosed to drive continuous progress and accountability.

A Sustainable Procurement Steering Committee, consisting of representatives from Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, and Compliance departments, oversees the policy's effectiveness, monitors progress, and addresses any gaps or challenges. Regular audits and reviews will be conducted to assess supplier compliance and overall policy impact, with corrective actions implemented to ensure the highest standards of sustainability are maintained.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Purchase & Procurement Manager will conduct an annual review of the Sustainable Procurement Policy to ensure its effectiveness, relevance, and alignment with our sustainability goals and regulatory standards.
